author: ruisantos
quote:
One of the most disappointing gaming experiences in recent memory. For a franchise built around player freedom, the amount of restrictions, linear mission design and heavily scripted sequences is embarrassing.

I own both the PS5 and Xbox Series X versions, and surprisingly, the Xbox version suffers from fewer FPS drops than the PS5 version. However, neither version delivers the level of technical polish expected from Rockstar, with numerous bugs, performance inconsistencies and immersion-breaking issues.

The writing is equally disappointing. The ideological messaging is painfully obvious, and many missions feel more concerned with promoting a particular perspective than providing an entertaining experience. The female protagonist is absolutely insufferable, with irritating dialogue, forced characterization and very little charisma.

The franchise's signature humor, satire, creative freedom and rebellious identity feel heavily diluted. Instead of allowing players to escape into a chaotic open world, Rockstar constantly dictates how they should play and what they should experience.

An enormous budget, years of development and countless broken expectations. A massive regression disguised as innovation.

0/10.

author: ruisantos
quote:
An absolute disappointment and a betrayal of what made GTA such an iconic franchise. For a game that supposedly revolves around freedom, the experience feels incredibly restrictive, with heavily scripted missions and very little room for genuine player creativity.

The technical performance is unacceptable, with numerous bugs, noticeable FPS drops and a serious lack of polish.

The writing is arguably even worse. The ideological messaging feels forced rather than naturally integrated into the narrative. Many missions are written from an overwhelmingly gender-focused perspective, sacrificing entertainment, authenticity and the irreverent humor that previously defined GTA. The female protagonist is particularly insufferable, with irritating dialogue, an unlikeable personality and painfully forced characterization.

Instead of delivering an entertaining sandbox experience, Rockstar seems more concerned with pushing a particular worldview and dictating how players should experience the game.

A complete disappointment that fails to live up to the franchise's legacy.

0/10.
